method: A branch group is applied only when this file names the listing ids and cites a public page with a quote and the day the page was read. Each member must match that page on city, ZIP, and street number. fast_mode would cluster listings by similar names. It is false. The site config branch_groups.fast_mode is also false. The builder stops if either flag is not false, because that clustering is not implemented. The same name, a shared website, or a franchise or platform label does not create a group. A group does not change the ownership label. listed_location_count is the number of directory records in the group, which are the locations the cited page lists that this directory carries. It is not an exhaustive national total.

groups.name: Dave's World
groups.evidence_quote: Proudly Serving All of Maine Out of Our 7 Locations
groups.scope: Dave's World locations page lists these seven Maine addresses as its locations. Each directory record matched that page on city, ZIP, and street number. Dover-Foxcroft and Presque Isle phones in the Efficiency Maine roster are general numbers the same page also prints (800.432.8786 and 207-432-8786); the page lists a local phone at those two addresses as well (207.802.1029 and 207.554.5120). Edgecomb is 31 US-1 on the page and 31 Route One in the roster. The count is these matched directory records. It is not a separate census of every place the company might operate.
